def _is_safe_path(member_name, dest_dir):
    """Check if a member's name would stay inside dest_dir when extracted."""
    # Ensure dest_dir ends with a separator for consistent comparison
    dest_path = os.path.join(dest_dir, member_name)
    
    # Get the directory portion of the resolved path

    # The directory part must be either dest_dir itself or a subdirectory of it

        if not (normalized_dir == normalized_dest or normalized_dir.startswith(normalized_dest + os.sep)):
